_rule: The local-first case, as verified law: every line quotes or cites the primary text, links it, and gives the date checked. The full costed case for a whole company is the enterprise design.

enterprise.what: The full enterprise design for a modelled 1,200-person bank: architecture, capacity, a five-year cost against Copilot-style seats and cloud APIs (seats, tokens, hardware, power, people, compliance — every price sourced), the compliance map, a sealed go/no-go board, the team and the rollout.

removes.what: An AI processor for inference — no vendor processes the prompts or answers, so there is no processor contract, due diligence or monitoring for it
International transfers for inference — nothing leaves the building to be assessed
removes.ref: EU GDPR Art 44; UK Chapter V as amended by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, in force 5 February 2026 (SI 2026/82 reg 2)

removes.what: Vendor retention of what staff and customers typed — prompts and answers stay on the company's machines, the strongest form of data protection by design
Evidence held by someone else — every step is a signed receipt the company keeps
removes.ref: GDPR Art 5(2) accountability; EU AI Act Art 26(6) logs for high-risk uses

stays.what: A lawful basis for each use
A DPIA — the ICO lists processing with innovative technology, including AI, as needing one when combined with the European criteria
stays.ref: Art 35; ICO list of high-risk processing

stays.what: Accuracy — this run measured the small models well short of answering customers alone
Security — on a local stack all of it is in-house
Safeguards for significant decisions made solely by automated means
stays.ref: EU Art 22; UK Arts 22A–22D (Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 s.80, in force 5 February 2026)

stays.what: Building an AI system for your own use makes you its provider under the AI Act
stays.ref: EU AI Act Art 3(3), 3(11); in scope for a UK firm when the output is used in the EU, Art 2(1)(c)

stays.what: Telling people when they are talking to an AI — applies since 2 August 2026
AI literacy for staff — applies since 2 February 2025
stays.ref: EU AI Act Art 4, as replaced by the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)

stays.what: High-risk duties (for example credit scoring) — from 2 December 2027, moved from 2 August 2026 by the Digital Omnibus
stays.ref: EU AI Act Annex III; Art 113 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744

costShape.what: Seats × people, plus tokens × volume. The bill grows with headcount and with use.
Capacity the company owns — the laptops it already has and a few inference nodes — plus the people who run it. Growth costs hardware in steps; the power is measured.
